Beneath the {wiki:Ghostland|Ghostlands} and the {wiki:Isle of the Kings|Isle of the Kings} hides the Queen of the Banshees, protected by seven seals. Cross the catacombs, solve the puzzles of each seal (flames, levers, blood, pearls), receive the kiss of {npc:The Queen Of The Banshees} and enter the final room to take {item:Boots of Haste}, {item:Giant Sword}, {item:Tower Shield}, {item:Stealth Ring}, {item:Stone Skin Amulet} and 100 platinum coins.

You have to complete 7 seals to reach the final room with the rewards. **Do not** enter the third floor of the Isle of the Kings or you will have to pay a certain amount of money. If you teleport out, you will have to return to the island through the pearl seal.
Minimum level **60**: below that the Queen won't let you finish the last seal (80+ recommended).
any container with blood, for the Seal of Sacrifice
optional, useful in the Seal of Demonrage
Do the seals **in the order of this guide** (it is the fastest), even if the official seal numbers are different.
If you stop halfway, you have to go back the way you came. If you go all the way to the last seal (the Queen), you are teleported back to the Ghostlands without having to kill anything again.
**Do not** enter the third floor of the Isle of the Kings: you would have to pay money.
Bring a player with {spell:Ultimate Explosion|UE} to the Queen's room, it helps a lot.

Go to **Carlin** (by boat: say {key:hi}, {key:carlin} and {key:yes} to the harbour captain of your city; you arrive next to {npc:Captain Greyhound}). To the **west** of the city are the {wiki:Ghostlands}: enter them by passing under the wall through the marked hole. Then head **south** to the quest entrance hole.
Hole under the wall to the Ghostlands
Go to the {wiki:Ghostland|Ghostlands} and go down through the hole at this spot. Bring a {item:Rope} and a {item:Pick}: you will need them to move on and to come back.

Head **south** and go down another hole. Here there are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Skeleton Warrior|Skeleton Warriors}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and a few {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}.
Path on the first underground floor
Head **southeast** and go down the hole.
Path to the hole in the southeast
Open the Magic Walls with 2 levers

Go to the {item:Magic Wall|Magic Walls} **east** of the rope spot. To open them you have to pull **2 levers**: one in the **west** and another in the **east** (red arrows in the image). Then go up the stairs marked **B** in the image.
The two levers (red arrows) and stairs B

The east lever is guarded by a {creature:Giant Spider}. To reach the west one you pass many {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}, 3 {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and a few {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}; in the lever room there are 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, 1 Demon Skeleton, 2–3 {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} and Ghouls.

Alone, pull the **east** lever first and then the **west** one, and use haste right after the second: the Magic Walls close again when someone steps on the **hidden buttons** on the path beyond them (1st and 2nd sqm on the left). In a team, one person goes to each lever, the others pass through, and when the lever pullers come back nobody can go back, otherwise the walls close and have to be opened again.
Go down and cross the Mummies room
After the Magic Walls, go down through the hole (the teleport is for coming back if the Magic Walls have closed). Head **north** in this room and clear it.
Room after the Magic Walls (teleports A and D)
Here there are {creature:Mummy|Mummies}, {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Stalker|Stalkers}.

At the top of the room there is a stone surrounded by poison fields. Walk over the poison fields: a lever appears beneath them. Use it to reveal some stairs. Go down the stairs and enter the teleport (A). (The teleport on the other side, D, takes you back to the Magic Walls.)
Optional: the body at the top of the room has junk and a book, Brother Fugio's diary, which is important for {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest|The White Raven Monastery Quest}.
Head **south** along this long corridor and use the {item:Pick} **in the middle of the corridor**, at the spot shown by the red arrows. Go down the hole into the first seal room.
Where to use the Pick (red arrows), rope spot B and round chamber C
If you keep going south all the way, you get teleported back.

In the room there is a blue flame. **All** team members have to walk through it; for each one that passes, 2 {creature:Ghost|Ghosts} and 1 {creature:Demon Skeleton} appear. After the flame you are teleported to a small room with another teleport: enter it to return to the first seal room. **1st seal done.**
In this room there are two {item:Monument|Monuments}: one reads *"Brasik'thar belek Fatuhr"* and the other *"Krak uthl belom Muhl!"*.

Head **south**, climb up with the rope (B in the previous image) and continue south. At the end go **west**, go up the ramp and go down into a round chamber (C in the 1st seal image). Here there are 3 {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, 3 {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} and 4 {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}. Go down the stairs.

From A, go as far **southeast** as possible to the seal. Set the levers **exactly as in the second image**, walk through the flame and come back through the teleport. Only one person needs to do this for the others to pass. **2nd seal done.**
Path from A to the Seal of Logic (B = stairs to the northwest)
On the way: {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, {creature:Stalker|Stalkers}, {creature:Demon Skeleton} and many {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}.
In the seal room there is a Monument with the text *"Shur Amashu Akur belak Uhr"*.

Go back to the stairs in the **northwest** part of this floor (B in the previous image) and go down; you will meet Ghosts. You have to go from the stairs you came down (A) to stairs B. On the way there are 10 {creature:Banshee|Banshees}, but never more than 3 at a time and you can usually lure them one by one.
From A to B, through the Banshees area
On the way there is a quest door with a box that contains the {item:Spectral Dress}, needed for the {wiki:Explorer Society Quest|Explorer Society Quest}.
Step on the tiles of the right path

Head **northwest** to the stairs (from A to B in the image). Careful, there is one more Banshee. Go up and walk on the tiles **exactly as in the second image**. Walk through the flame and come back through the teleport. **3rd seal done.**
From A to stairs B (C = stairs to the north, to the next seal)
Tiles you have to walk on

Go back down and head to the stairs in the **north** (C in the previous image). Go up into a room with 5 {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, 5 {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} and 2 {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}. Go down the other stairs and follow the path to the next stairs. The next room is full of poison fields, Ghosts and Demon Skeletons. Go up the stairs: you are at point A in the image. Head **north**; the seal is in the north corner of the room.
Path to the Seal of Sacrifice

Use the {item:Blood} and pour it **between the two stones**, on the tile that looks like the depot tiles. You should see a small animation on the stone tables around. Walk through the flame and come back through the teleport. **4th seal done.**
Tile where to pour the blood
Continue up the stairs in the blood room (B in the previous image) and go from A to B; then again from A to B.
Path to the Seal of Demonrage
Step on the tile and kill the Warlocks

In the narrow corridor to the south there are 2 special tiles, like the ones in front of the depot. **Each player** has to step on one of them; for each person, 2 {creature:Warlock|Warlocks} appear: one **north** of the tiles (in the corridor) and another to the **south**, in the room below (usually in the northeast corner). Stepping on it again does not make more appear.

The ideal is for the main blocker to go down first and hold one Warlock while the team kills the other; then the blocker comes back up and the team kills the second one. Whoever steps on the tile should only step and return to the corridor (unless they are the blocker).

Alone and unable to kill 2 Warlocks? Ignore them and pull the levers while constantly healing yourself. Watch out for the fire fields they throw onto the levers (bring {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field Runes}). No rush.
After the whole team has stepped on a tile, **each person** pulls the levers in the order shown in the image and walks through the fire. **5th seal done.**
Lever order for the Seal of Demonrage

Follow the image: go from A to B in **Image 1**, you reach C in **Image 2** and head **north** (there are 2 {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}). Use the {item:Pick} at the marked spot and you drop down to **Image 3**: there, go from A to B (there is nothing to kill). Go up at B and you reach **Image 4**, with many Demon Skeletons and other creatures. Go from A to B and use the Pick to enter the seal room.
Images 1 to 4 of the path to the Plague Seal

In the middle of Image 4 you pass a rope spot that leads to the catacombs of the Isle of the Kings: it is the fastest way out of the quest from here. On the island, to return to the mainland, talk to {npc:Captain Jack} on the docked boat ({key:hi}, {key:tibia}); he takes you to the Carlin side.

Go down through the Pick hole and kill more Demon Skeletons. Place the {item:Black Pearl} and the {item:White Pearl} at the spots shown in the image and go through the teleport (the left or the right one, it doesn't matter).

Head **north** through some poison fields and enter the teleport at the end of the path. In the room where you arrive, enter the teleport that is there: you return to the place behind the pearl teleport. Enter the teleports from there to return to the sacrifice tables. **6th seal done.**
7. Last seal: The Kiss of the Banshee Queen

Go to {npc:The Queen Of The Banshees} (she is near the Seal of Sacrifice). She is surrounded by 4 {creature:Banshee|Banshees}, 2 {creature:Mummy|Mummies}, 2 {creature:Ghost|Ghosts} and 3 {creature:Stalker|Stalkers}: kill them carefully.
A UE helps clear the creatures around the Queen

After killing all the Banshees around her, talk to her: {key:hi}, {key:seventh seal}, then {key:yes} **six times**, {key:kiss} and {key:yes}. You are teleported to a small room with a *"your dead body"*. Go up the stairs and you return to the surface of the Ghostlands. To return to Carlin, leave the Ghostlands through the hole under the wall.
If you are not **level 60** you can't finish this seal: the Queen says you don't have enough experience.

The final room is **west** of the Banshee Queen. You have to go back there again from the Ghostlands (you can also go through the {wiki:Isle of the Kings|Isle of the Kings}). Via the Ghostlands, repeat the path of the previous sections from the entrance hole. Via the Isle of the Kings: {npc:Dalbrect}, at the harbour north and west of Carlin, takes you to the island ({key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}, only after the Family Brooch from {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest}); go down to the catacombs ({npc:Costello} has to let you through: {key:Brother Fugio}) to the rope spot that connects to the Plague Seal area.
Bring **280–300 free capacity** for the rewards. After you go down the stairs to the final room **you can't go back up**.
Dalbrect (boat to the Isle of the Kings)
Clear the room and collect the rewards

The room has 6 {creature:Banshee|Banshees}, 2 {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and 2 {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}; you usually have to lure them (it depends on the situation). Kill everything and pick up the rewards.
The final room with the rewards
Boots of Haste, Giant Sword, Tower Shield, Stealth Ring, Stone Skin Amulet and 100 platinum coins

When you have everything, enter the {item:Magic Forcefield}: you are teleported to the surface of the Ghostlands. To return to Carlin, head **northeast** to the hole under the wall and cross to the city side.
After you pass through the Magic Forcefield **you can't go back in**. Make sure you have picked up all the rewards.

The official seal names follow a different numbering: Hidden Seal (1st), Plague Seal (2nd), Seal of Demonrage (3rd), Seal of Sacrifice (4th), Seal of True Path (5th), Seal of Logic (6th) and Kiss of the Banshee Queen (7th). The order in this guide is the fastest.
If you teleport out halfway, to return to the island you have to use the pearl seal.
